# `silk/platform/native/start_sync`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

A minimal start code for a native program whose `main` is an `i32` effect that requires `&mut
HostInput`.

## When to use
Select this runtime explicitly when you want no execution and no diagnostics. The default
runtime, `silk.platform.native.start`, accepts more kinds of `main` and prints a report for an unhandled
error.

## Details
The runtime copies the arguments and the environment, gives them to `main` as an `OsHostInput`,
and releases them after `main` returns. Your code provides every other requirement, such as the
`Allocator` that `HostInput` lookups need. An error during start or an unhandled error of `main`
returns status 1, without a report.

## Gotchas
- `main` must be an effect that returns `i32` and requires `&mut HostInput`. A plain `i32`,
  `()`, other requirements, or parking need another runtime.
- A trap does not unwind, so cleanup code does not run.
- The runtime exists only on Darwin on aarch64, and Linux with GNU libc on x86_64 or aarch64.
